question: Who among the following is known as 'Captain Cool' in Indian Cricket?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mahendra Singh Dhoni**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• **Mahendra Singh Dhoni** is a former Indian cricketer and captain of the Indian national team, known for his calm and composed demeanor on the field, earning him the nickname "Captain Cool".

• He led India to numerous victories, including the 2007 ICC World Twenty20, the 2010 and 2016 Asia Cups, the 2011 ICC Cricket World Cup, and the 2013 ICC Champions Trophy.

• Dhoni holds various records, such as the most wins by an Indian captain in Tests and ODIs, and the most successful wicket-keeper in Indian cricket history.

• Under his captaincy, India achieved the number one ranking in Test cricket for the first time in 2009.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Virat Kohli:**

• Virat Kohli is an Indian cricketer and former captain of the Indian national team.

• He is widely regarded as one of the best batsmen in the world and has numerous records to his name.

• Kohli has been awarded several prestigious awards, including the ICC Cricketer of the Year and the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna award.

• **Kapil Dev:**

• Kapil Dev is a former Indian cricketer and captain who led India to its first World Cup victory in 1983.

• He was an all-rounder, known for his fast bowling and aggressive batting.

• Kapil Dev was inducted into the ICC Cricket Hall of Fame in 2010.

• **Sachin Tendulkar:**

• Sachin Tendulkar is a former Indian cricketer widely regarded as one of the greatest batsmen in the history of cricket.

• He holds numerous records, including the most runs in both Test and ODI cricket, and the most centuries in international cricket.

• Tendulkar was awarded the Bharat Ratna, India’s highest civilian award, in 2014.
